metadata.description: OshO's Claude Code skills, hooks and global setup.

plugins.name: osho-core
plugins.description: Core hooks, skills and agents: repo-init (with Nobori's Git & CI process), donnees-fictives, audit-loop (auditor agent), escouade (Escouade ticket method), tache (Horizon Kanban task ↔ Claude Code session), code-review-graph auto-update, per-session Superpowers offer, revue-artefact (plans, specs, dev reports and questions as an artifact page the user ticks).

plugins.name: osho-mantis
plugins.description: Mantis security audits from Claude Code, no API key: quick triage, Light→Overkill campaign, live dashboard (follow and steer the audit from the browser, Cycle view per round, read-only Claude feed, launch without the terminal), one-click fixes merged into a local audit branch, French report and bilan, developer exports (HTML or full zip), estimated cost and time, crash-safe resume.
